The excerpt does not specify whether complex survey sampling weights or replicate weights were applied in the production of the reported percentages, nor does it name any weight variables. Because the note is not an individual-level predictive/ML analysis, the key requirement for analysts using the underlying TALIS Starting Strong database is to follow the official TALIS Starting Strong sampling and weighting documentation for each participating entity and ECEC level (under age 3 vs pre-primary ISCED 02). data.outcome_summary: TALIS Starting Strong 2024 is an OECD large-scale survey of early childhood education and care (ECEC) staff and setting leaders, using questionnaires to capture staff/leader demographics, training and professional development, daily work practices, well-being and job satisfaction, and governance/oversight arrangements. This participant note summarizes results for the Flemish Community of Belgium across two ECEC levels: home-based and centre-based childcare for children under age 3, and pre-primary education (ISCED 02) from age 2.5 to entry into primary school. The report provides indicator-based comparisons with other participating countries and subnational entities, and it cautions that estimates may be affected by non-response bias when response rates do not meet technical standards. The excerpt does not report any predictive model performance metrics or plausible-value-based achievement scaling; instead, it reports descriptive percentages and percentage-point differences from the TALIS Starting Strong 2024 database. Policy relevance is framed through workforce quality and retention (education, stress, training access) and system foundations (feedback, collaboration, inspection/monitoring, and administrative burden).
